description: The RFC 7516 A.5 flattened JWE (alg and kid in the per-recipient header, jku in the shared unprotected header) decrypts with the A.3 A128KW key. No jwe.encrypt vector reproduces it: polyjose's encryptor always puts alg in the protected header of a flattened JWE and in the recipient's header of a general one, never in the per-recipient header of a flattened JWE (documented omission for 0.1.0, plan.md lead refinement 15; jwe_json.rs shows the output differs only in where alg sits)
